title: Average height of American men (centimeters)

source.name: A century of trends in adult human height

notes: NCD-RisC's 2016 eLife study pooled 18.6 million adults across 200 countries, tracking cohorts who turned 18 from 1914 to 2014. American men gained about 6 centimeters over the century, from roughly 171cm to 177cm.
